case_name: Rakesh Kumar v. Ritu Kumar — Full Case Name
facts_of_case: The parties are the parents of a minor child. The petitioner (father) sought custody of the child, while the respondent (mother) resisted it. The trial court granted custody to the respondent. This appeal is against that order.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking custody to prove that the other parent is unfit.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking custody to prove that the other parent is unfit. The court cannot take a decision based on mere allegations or suspicions.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant custody to a party who is unfit or incapable of providing proper care and upbringing.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the court will not grant custody to a party who is unfit or incapable of providing proper care and upbringing. The child's welfare is paramount, and the court must ensure that the child is placed in a safe and stable environment.

outcome.final_order: The final order was that the custody of the minor child be given to the petitioner (father).
